field_mappings.transformation: Parse the ABN cell as a typed ABN identifier using the native ABN header as type evidence (require_label false), strip separators, validate the 11-digit ABN checksum, and reject invalid values.
Parse the ACN cell as a typed ACN identifier using the native ACN header as type evidence (require_label false), strip separators, validate the 9-digit ACN checksum, and do not emit blank values.
Preserve the licensee business address text as a whole with whitespace collapsed; do not split into locality, state or postcode.

unmapped_fields.reason: Licensee Name is the name of the licensee, and the supplied evidence does not establish it as the registered or legal name of a business entity; individual licensees carry person names. entity.legal_name therefore remains unresolved.
Financial category code is a licence classification, not a documented ANZSIC industry code or canonical entity status; no independent canonical output is supported.
Financial category description is a licence classification, not a documented ANZSIC industry code or canonical entity status; no independent canonical output is supported.
Licence class describes the licence scope and is not a documented canonical field in the assignment ontology subset.
Licence grade describes the licence level and is not a documented canonical field in the assignment ontology subset.
Licence number is a licence identifier, not an ABN, ACN or NZBN; no canonical entity identifier is supported.
Licence type code has no documented code meaning in the supplied source documentation, so it cannot be crosswalked to entity_type without inventing a category mapping.
Licence type description (Company/Individual) is not documented as an entity_type crosswalk; entity_type defaults to unknown and no explicit mapping is supplied.
Row identifier is a native row key in the extracted prefix, not a business identifier or canonical field.
